title: Impact of SSKI Pre-Treatment on Blood Loss in Thyroidectomy for Graves Disease
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether a brief course of SSKI (saturated solution of potassium iodide) administered preoperatively provides any benefit in the surgical management of patients undergoing thyroidectomy as definitive management of their Graves Disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients with a clinical diagnosis of Graves Disease
* Patients who have selected surgical resection as treatment of their Graves Disease
* Prior use of anti thyroid medication so that patient is clinically and biochemically euthyroid

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients deemed unfit for surgery by operating surgeon or anesthesist
* Patients who are clinically hyperthyroid or have T3 or T4 levels 2X the upper limit of normal
